camp.name: FOOTYUP Boston College Combine 2027 — Middlesex School

event.name: FOOTYUP x GOINGFORGOAT Boston College Combine
event.infoText:
Players will participate in an elite three-day college soccer combine at Middlesex School in Concord, MA, designed to provide exposure to college coaches, professional athletic performance testing, and high-level competition.

Every registered player will receive an exclusive GOINGFORGOAT x FOOTYUP package, shipped directly to their home before the combine, including combine kits and additional player gear.

Athletes take part in competitive training sessions, small-sided games, full-field matches, and advanced athletic performance testing using VALD technology.
